content: As a Jew, I’d say: *"I’m here for you, but don’t expect me to fix everything—even God took a day off."* Toxic? Maybe. Honest? Absolutely. Family love doesn’t mean endless sacrifice; boundaries matter. (And yes, I’ll still bring the matzo ball soup.)
